title: fix(spec, core, plugin-security, plugin-approvals, plugin-audit, service-analytics): platform refusals carry a userMessage in the caller's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GcFrQHeJCJW3RrHoCjTnRP)_

Fixes #34699 (server rows 1, 3, 4 and 5 as narrowed by the card's `Premise corrected`; the ui rows live on #34740)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录锁定、记录不存在(或无权访问)、按无权字段查询、超出委派管理范围这四类平台拒绝，现在都带一句面向最终用户的 `userMessage`,按请求语言(否则工作区默认语言，再否则英文)给出；code、状态码与 message 不变。
- 为什么改：中文用户此前看到的是英文的诊断句(含 API 名、id、字段名);控制台本来就优先显示 `userMessage`,缺的是服务端没给。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个字段，不改既有字段；回滚 = 还原本 PR。新句子不点名字段、id 或对象，不泄露存在性(不存在与无权读同一句)。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`(两处标注)、`packages/core/src/utils/record-not-found.ts`、`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`(新增三键四语)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/platform-refusal-user-message.test.ts`,预期 10 条全绿，其中 zh-CN 用例断言中文句子。
- 需要你做的：契约复审尚欠(contract review owed),之后 Tier H 交 os-zhuang 批。

## What changes

The platform answers four refusals with an end user's sentence on `userMessage`, in the caller's language: the request `locale`, else `workspaceLocale`, else `en` (the ladder the operation-message catalog already uses). `code`, HTTP status and `message` do not move; the operator half stays in `message`.

| Row | Refusal | Key | Producers marked |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | per-row record lock (`RECORD_LOCKED`) | existing lock sentence | `plugin-approvals` `lifecycle-hooks.ts`: only the per-row lock; the three operator-facing bound refusals stay unmarked |
| 3 | `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | `record_not_found` (new) | `recordNotFoundError` in `@objectstack/core`, now taking the caller; every call site that has a context passes it |
| 4 | masked-field query refusal (`PERMISSION_DENIED`) | `query_field_not_readable` (new) | all four producers: the security middleware's filter-oracle guard, `plugin-approvals` `payload-predicate-guard.ts`, `plugin-audit` `parent-field-query-guard.ts`, `service-analytics` `field-read-admission.ts`; the aggregate-role refusals stay unmarked (they are not row queries) |
| 5 | `DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION` | `delegation_scope_violation` (new) | the security middleware's delegated-administration gate catch |

- `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`: three placeholder-free keys in `en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`. None names a field, id, object or wire code. `record_not_found` reads the same for a missing row and an unreadable one (ruling 5985885287, existence hiding).
- `packages/core/src/utils/operation-user-message.ts` (new, exported): `operationUserMessage(key, caller)` resolves the ladder against `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` and renders through `renderOperationMessage` with the built-in catalog. It is for producers that hold no `i18n` service, so it consults no deployment `errors.<key>` override; the security middleware's markings go through its own `userFacingDenialMessage`, which does. The caller is typed `object` (any context) and its `locale` / `workspaceLocale` are read defensively.
- `mapDataError` and the batch-row classifier already relay a declared `userMessage`; nothing in the transport changed.
- Docs: the flat `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` body examples in `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx` and `error-handling.mdx` now show `userMessage`.
- Not given a caller: the MCP sites, `refuseDeniedSubjectLoad`, `assertRecordExists` (no caller context in reach). Their not-found now carries the English `userMessage`; the MCP data doors relay it, the MCP metadata door carries no `userMessage` channel and answers as before.

## Tests

New:
- `plugin-security/src/platform-refusal-user-message.test.ts` (10): real `ObjectQL` over a real `SqlDriver` with the real `SecurityPlugin`; zh-CN, workspace fallback and `en` for rows 3, 4, 5, plus relay through the real `mapDataError`, plus a CONTROL that a readable query is admitted. The delegated gate is a stub that throws the gate's real error class (the gate's own verdicts are pinned in `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`).
- `core/src/utils/operation-user-message.test.ts` (7): the ladder and the not-found envelope.
- `spec/src/system/operation-message.test.ts`: every locale defines the three keys, no placeholders, no wire vocabulary, distinct texts, zh-CN render, unknown-locale fallback, deployment override.
- zh-CN cases added to `payload-predicate-guard.test.ts`, `activity-predicate-guard.test.ts`, `field-read-admission-gate.test.ts`, `record-lock-user-facing-message.test.ts`.

Forced changes (tests that pin the exact error shape, now expecting the added field):
- `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.batch-row-driver-text.test.ts`, `protocol.batch-row-http-status.test.ts`: the not-found batch row now carries `userMessage`.
- `runtime/src/batch-row-http-status-real-driver.integration.test.ts`: same.
- `plugin-approvals/src/record-lock-batch-row-status.integration.test.ts`: the lock row carries `userMessage`; its own-property list ends `statusCode, userMessage`.
- `rest/src/record-field-access-route.test.ts`: the stub of the read path's not-found is now built by the real `recordNotFoundError`, so the "same 404 as the read path" comparison compares like with like.
- `mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` (data-door sites) and `mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.not-found.test.ts`: the MCP not-found envelope carries the English `userMessage`.
- `runtime/src/duplicate-record-user-message-doors-33790.test.ts` CONTROL: "a row whose producer marked nothing" used an id naming no row, which is now marked; it moves to a write naming an undeclared field. Its assertion (no `userMessage`) is unchanged.

Ablation (each leg red, then restored; `git diff HEAD` empty on the touched source afterwards):

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | filter-oracle guard rethrows without the marking | 3 failed / 10 |
| 2 | delegation marking disabled | 3 failed / 10 |
| 3 | `recordNotFoundError` marking deleted | 2 failed / 7 (core) |
| 4 | record lock `lockedError(sentence)` without the user half | 2 failed / 19 |

## Acceptance notes

- Row 4's masked-field query is still served under Modify All on the object; that is the known open half of #33828, not widened or narrowed here. The new test grants no per-object Modify All.
- The ui half (rows 6 and 8) is #34740.

## Verification

Package suites (shared box, under the verify lock): core, plugin-security, plugin-approvals, plugin-audit, service-analytics, service-print, metadata-protocol, rest, objectql (13603 tests), runtime, spec (27174 tests). The first run surfaced the six forced shape pins above; each failing file was re-run green after its fix.

Merge-tree against the open PRs that share a file (none shares a hunk), and against main:

| Against | Head | `git merge-tree` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #34734 (`action-execution.ts`) | `08a588b12b` | exit 0, 0 conflicts |
| #34709 (`engine-update.ts`) | `13741cb992` | exit 0, 0 conflicts |
| #34565 (`engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`) | `779d1aa330` | exit 0, 0 conflicts |
| `origin/main` | `6dd5716329` | exit 0 |

Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 102 for this file surface. After a full `turbo run build`, all 102 ran at `21b0016086`: 101 exit 0, and `check:test-source-alias` exit 1 on three test files this change edits (their source under test loads a dependency inside a function body). `f3d1774be2` adds the module-top imports the gate asks for; the gate then exits 0 and the three files re-run green. `f8ef82d7bb` adds the two doc examples, which derive 23 more docs gates: all 23 exit 0, and the four earlier doc-reading gates (`check:doc-authoring`, `check-affected-docs`, `check-drift-comment`, spec `check:docs`) re-ran exit 0. Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` → 125 derived, 125 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. CI's workspace type check then caught a weak-type error (a context declaring neither locale field was refused for the caller type) in `plugin-audit` and the rest test; `1fce1406e2` types the caller as `object`, and `turbo run typecheck` over the 11 touched packages passes (52/52 tasks). CI's Test Core shard 9 then caught the two MCP shape pins above; `d50700b346` updates them. Before that push, the two MCP files re-ran green, and the other packages whose tests name the not-found refusal ran locally, all exit 0: plugin-auth, service-settings, downstream-contract, client, driver-sql, organizations, plugin-sharing, http-conformance, scenarios, service-mailbox, service-storage, verify, plugin-hono-server, types. `check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 21 anchors judged, 0 lost. `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed `.ts` files: exit 0.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Only catalog strings added.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint run on the changed files.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (No generated artifact moves: the keys are catalog strings, not schema.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
